title: 🔆🔅First footage released of an American submersible drone that was seized by Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz.
text:
🔆🔅First footage released of an American submersible drone that was seized by Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz."
"IRGC Seizes Advanced U.S. Submarine Drone in Strategic Strait of Hormuz"

"Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy announced on Tuesday that it has detected and seized an American unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz."

"According to Statement No. 12 issued by the IRGC Navy, the operation took place in the early hours of Tuesday as part of a complex intelligence and operational mission. The IRGC said the underwater drone was equipped with advanced surveillance and reconnaissance technologies and had been delivered to the U.S. Navy in 2025."

"The IRGC Navy confirmed that the vehicle is now in Iranian possession and stated that images of the seized system would be released in the coming hours. The seizure marks the latest escalation in the ongoing standoff between Tehran and Washington over control of the strategic waterway."

"Source: Pool, IRGC
